name: Fresh-corn porridge
summary: Cháo bẹ is a porridge of fresh young corn flour from the northern route.
howToEat: Look for it in the northern-route kitchens. A version with greens and bamboo shoot goes by cháo bẹ rau măng.
seoTitle: Fresh-corn porridge on the north road
seoDescription: Cháo bẹ is a porridge of fresh young corn flour from the northern route.
